description:
Create a multi-asset verification request. Allows verifying multiple assets (phone, email, domain, social, wallet, account, telegram_bot) in a single flow.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

action_context.description: Context displayed to user during verification

title.description: Action title shown to user (required for custom/confirmation)

allowed_channels.description: Restrict to specific channels for this asset

identifier.description: The identifier to verify (phone number, email, domain, etc.). If omitted, the user provides their own.

required.description: Whether this asset must be verified for the request to complete (default: true)

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for status updates (HTTPS only)

proof_expiry_days.description: Per-request proof expiry override in days (7, 30, 90, or 365)

redirect_url.description: URL to redirect user after verification completes (HTTPS only)

reference_id.description: Your unique reference ID for this request

name: create_verification_request
